Bs.draw: SHA-256 counter stream keyed by (model sha256, mode, rate, seed, focal genes); Fisher-Yates over the eligible reactions, then one replacement gene per reaction; replacement genes exclude the focal genes so the wrong assignment is not self-cancelling
Bs.rule_semantics: the drawn reaction's whole rule is replaced by a single wrong gene
